description: This file defines the WindowPlacement enum with static helper functions for positioning NSWindow instances on the screen, including centering, positioning at the top right, anchoring below a rect, and ensuring the window remains on visible screens.

methods.name: centeredFrame(size:on:)
methods.description: Calculates a frame centered within the specified screen bounds.

methods.name: topRightFrame(size:padding:on:)
methods.description: Calculates a frame positioned at the top right of the specified screen bounds with padding.

methods.name: centeredFrame(size:in:)
methods.description: Calculates a frame centered within the given bounds rectangle.

methods.name: topRightFrame(size:padding:in:)
methods.description: Calculates a frame at the top right within the specified bounds with padding.

methods.name: anchoredBelowFrame(size:anchor:padding:in:)
methods.description: Calculates a frame anchored below an existing rect, with bounds clamping.

methods.name: ensureOnScreen(window:defaultSize:fallback:)
methods.description: Adjusts window position to ensure it is visible on at least one screen, centering if necessary.
